// Copy to cmd/starter/main.go after generating home_gen.go.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/goxml-starter"
	"github.com/goxml/goxml/pkg/runtime/app"
)

func main() {
	view, err := starter.NewGoxmlHomeView(starter.NewViewModel())
	if err == nil {
		err = app.Run(view, app.Config{Title: "Goxml starter", Width: 480, Height: 240})
	}
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
